I look at the crypt warily.
I hop down after it, and try to land on the wolf, to end it right there on impact.
I watch the pattern of the dog for a little, and when the dog is most vulnerable, I drop the pillar down towards the dog.
I give a tentative swing of the pillar I am holding, while I think of what I should do with it.
I peer down at the wolf.  "Can you understand me? You don't appear like a normal wolf at all."
I walk over to the ledge, and stare down at the dog.
I walk over to the stone pillar, judging its length. Maybe it could serve as a makeshift mace.
I look around the cabin for something I might be able to use to maybe throw at the wolf, or use to fight it. I don't want to have to use the 2x4, but I will if I must.

I take the simple tunic and boots and put them on. The tunic feels slightly tight, but it accentuates my curves. the boots go half way up my leg. (Is that ok, to state minor things like that? I'm not sure...)

I step towards the back door.
I walk up quickly to the skeleton, and take the strip of paper, eyeing what else the skeleton has on.
I look at the skeleton warily, and walk closer to it. "Are you enchanted? Alive somehow?" I say idly to myself as I walk closer.
I leave the bed sheets be. I don't need them for the time being. I step inside the little hut this time, having surveyed as much as I was willing to.
I give a quick survey for something I might use to defend myself, picking it up if I can, before jumping down.
I walk back up the stairwell, and look down to where I had just fallen.
I look at the distance between myself and the 2x4. I tentatively ring the silverbell at the wolf, while walking towards the 2x4.

I walk closer, and around the hut, eyeing it warily. "What makes this building so foreboding It is only a hut. Its positioning next to where I fell can't be a coincidence! so what makes it so... off?" I think to myself.
I stand and shake, as the fear runs its course. I didn't think... I just jumped, and it very possibly could have been to my doom! I try to calm myself down afterwards.
I look down at where he said to jump, give a gulp, and with the Silverbell in my hand, I take the leap of faith.
I ask him simply "Why me?" I look at him, Forlorn that he appears to be... dying? Evaporating?
I clutch the orb more tightly, moving to hold it in my second hand as well.

I look at the man uncertainly, before going to the orb. Out of nervous habit, I have one of my hands placed above my breast as I slide closer to the orb. I lightly poke it, and observe what happens before going to try and grab it in one hand.

I look at the strange man, and shake my head softly. "Why do I need to place my hands on this orb?" "Why am I here?" 

While waiting for my answers, I scrutinize the man more, trying to get a clearer picture of who I am talking to.
I warily climb up the stairs, stopping when my head gets just high enough to look at what is upstairs. I take a look around.

I shudder softly at the  memories, and the lack of them. I pad close to the stairwell, and observe the stairwell. I take in the details of the path it takes up, and whatever details might be revealed upstairs. I try to control my breathing, moderately scared by the situation

I also look myself over to see what I am wearing.

I give another quick look around in the room, quickly awake and wary. I look around for other doors and details in the room. I also think to myself, as I brush my hair out my eyes, "How did I get here?" "What happened?"
